'''''Timber''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]].

==History==
After [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s betrayal of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and failed coup d'etat against [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Palpatine]], he and his and his fleet focused their efforts on demolishing loyalist Imperial infrastructure, intending to strip the Empire of its growing technological advantage in starfighter superiority. One of his first targets were the [[TIE/ad starfighter]] production facilities in the [[Omar]] system: ''[[Omar 1]]'', ''[[Omar 2]]'', and ''[[Omar 3]]''. Sending a massive fleet that overwhelmed the local defenses, Zaarin left the loyalist Imperial forces with no other choice but to abandon the facilities and to save the surviving personnel on these stations. The ''Timber'' was one of the many Imperial transports assigned to rescue as many of the surviving crew as possible on ''Omar 1'', and then escape before Zaarin's forces could intercept it.

A retaliatory strike led by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] distracted Zaarin's forces long enough for the ''Timber'', the last vessel to arrive, to board ''Omar 1'' and retrieve the last of the Imperial personnel still stationed aboard. The ''Timber'' was able to escape, saving many Imperial workers before the facility was finished off by Zaarin's forces.
